description: React component for a Stripe payment form handling card input, validation, and submission.

methods.name: handleInputChange
methods.description: Handles change events from Stripe card input elements, updating validation state.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, creates payment method via Stripe, and manages donation state.

methods.name: handleAuthentication
methods.description: Confirms card payment with Stripe using client secret and payment method.
